Take a look at the help for ifelse() - if you want the variables switched (right now 1 is positive and 0 is negative), just switch the two numbers in the ifelse command.

If you type head(Broiler), you should see a 1 in the BRehang column for every time the SalmonRehang column says "POS" and 0 every time it says "NEG".
